item.title: GGI and OpenAD Partner to Transform LINE’s Mini Dapps Publishing & Monetization
item.dc:creator: MIXMARVEL
item.content:encoded:
[Singapore, May] — Galaxy Girl Interactive (GGI) is excited to announce its latest strategic collaboration with OpenAD, a decentralized in-app advertising solution built to help apps and mini-programs across emerging ecosystems achieve real user growth and efficient monetization through transparent, performance-based campaigns. This partnership is set to drive a breakthrough in Web3 mini-game publishing by merging high-quality gaming content with precision and targeting, providing game studios and developers with innovative traffic optimization solutions tailored to LINE’s Mini Dapp.

By bringing together GGI’s proven reputation as the ultimate portal for blockchain gaming — with its powerful incubation, publishing offerings, and high-quality game network — and OpenAD’s effective ad platform and distribution technique, the two companies are ready to bring about a revolutionary experience. OpenAD’s suite of flexible ad formats, quick bidding processes, and precise targeting capabilities ensures that gaming content reaches genuine, engaged audiences. Meanwhile, GGI’s deep connections within the industry — including its successful partnerships and investments in the LINE’s Mini Dapp ecosystem — provide an ongoing pipeline of exciting, quality content in preparation for wider adoption.

The partnership centers on integrating OpenAD’s decentralized advertising solutions into the realm of Web3 mini-games. This move is designed to facilitate efficient traffic exchanges between publishers and advertisers, enabling game studios to rapidly monetize their products while providing players with high-quality, curated gaming experiences. Through features like ad control and transparent, on-chain verification of ad performance, OpenAD not only guarantees that only unique, authentic views are charged but also delivers real-world results that drive scalable expansion.

GGI’s partnership with OpenAD highlights a significant industry trend: the convergence of digital advertising and blockchain gaming, leveraging massive consumer-facing messenger app traffic to propel on-chain games from niche markets into the mainstream. This innovative approach reflects the broader momentum within the Web3 space, where innovative ad tactics and sophisticated targeting techniques are becoming important to reach traditional and crypto-native consumers. “As we partner with OpenAD, we are optimizing traffic, but also shaping how gaming communities interact with and connect with content in the Web3 space,” said Jade, Co-founder of GGI. “This collaboration is indicative of our dedication to driving sustainable growth and innovation in blockchain gaming, while bringing tangible value to indie studios, publishers, and players across the ecosystem.”

With this partnership, GGI continues to lead the charge in transforming blockchain gaming by integrating powerful advertising tools with its expansive publishing network. Together, GGI and OpenAD are set to pave the way for a new era of Web3 mini-game publishing, uniting crypto gaming communities and enabling unprecedented levels of engagement and monetization on consumer applications and integrated platforms such as LINE.

Stay tuned for more updates as GGI and OpenAD unveil new initiatives that will further empower the Web3 gaming space and drive the evolution of digital advertising for gamers worldwide.

About GGI:

Galaxy Girl Interactive is a leading blockchain gaming platform committed to creating innovative gaming experiences through cutting-edge technology and strategic partnerships. GGI focuses on delivering high-quality games while fostering a vibrant gaming community.

About OpenAD:

OpenAD Protocol builds the first Permissionless Ad Network, which drives Real Results, User Growth and Profit with Real Data for our Partners.

OpenAD Protocol brings the power of digital advertising to the Telegram, LINE, TikTok and more ecosystem, unlocking seamless access to billions of active users!

OpenAD is thrilled to partner with LINE NEXT Inc., expanding our reach to millions of engaged users globally. This collaboration opens up new advertising opportunities, bringing precise targeting and seamless ad integration to LINE NEXT’s vibrant ecosystem. With LINE NEXT, OpenAD’s platform now offers enhanced visibility, stronger engagement, and new advertising formats to help businesses grow.

item.title: GGI and Shrapnel Forge Partnership to Revolutionize Web3 Gaming with Immersive, Player-Centric…
item.dc:creator: MIXMARVEL
item.content:encoded:
GGI and Shrapnel Forge Partnership to Revolutionize Web3 Gaming with Immersive, Player-Centric Experiences

[Feb, 2024] In a landmark move set to reshape the Web3 gaming landscape, GGI, the premier Web3 group powering the next generation of gaming innovation, has announced a partnership with Shrapnel, the Avalanche-based trailblazing FPS game backed by the Blizzard Avalanche Ecosystem Fund. This collaboration unites two industry powerhouses, combining GGI’s unparalleled ecosystem with Shrapnel’s cutting-edge gaming technology and visionary design, heralding a new era of immersive, player-centric experiences.

The partnership arrives at a pivotal moment for Shrapnel, as the studio welcomes its new CEO, Ken Rosman — a 30-year gaming industry veteran with a storied tenure at Microsoft’s Xbox division, where he contributed to iconic titles like Halo Wars and Sunset Overdrive. Rosman’s leadership will guide Shrapnel toward its full public launch. Additionally, Shrapnel has secured strategic investments from industry leaders, including the Blizzard Avalanche Ecosystem Fund, Griffin Gaming Partners, and Polychain Capital. These milestones highlight Shrapnel’s dedication to redefining blockchain gaming and delivering groundbreaking, player-first experiences.

A Synergy of Innovation and Excellence

GGI and Shrapnel are united by a shared vision: to accelerate the mass adoption of Web3 gaming by crafting high-quality, engaging experiences that seamlessly blend traditional gaming with the transformative potential of blockchain technology. By leveraging GGI’s robust ecosystem — spanning investment, content incubation, game publishing, and infrastructure — and Shrapnel’s expertise in gaming and immersive design, this partnership is poised to set a new standard for the gaming industry.

“Excited to join forces with GGI as we gear up to bring Shrapnel to more players worldwide.” — Ken Rosman, CEO of Shrapnel

GGI’s Ecosystem: A Catalyst for Web3 Gaming Success

GGI’s ecosystem stands as a beacon of innovation in the Web3 gaming space. With its affiliated brands — MixMarvel, Yeeha! Games, and the upcoming MIX Chain — GGI offers a comprehensive suite of services tailored to the needs of Web3 developers and gamers alike. From AI-powered game discovery to cross-chain interoperability solutions, GGI’s infrastructure ensures seamless integration and scalability for Shrapnel’s visionary projects.

“Shrapnel’s bold approach to blockchain gaming perfectly complements GGI’s mission to empower builders and connect players with the best Web3 experiences,” said a spokesperson from GGI. “We are excited to support Shrapnel’s journey and look forward to co-creating the future of gaming together.”

Charting the Future: A New Horizon for Web3 Gaming

The partnership between GGI and Shrapnel represents a quantum leap forward for the Web3 gaming industry. By combining GGI’s ecosystem strength with Shrapnel’s creative vision and technical prowess, this collaboration is set to deliver groundbreaking gaming experiences that captivate both traditional and Web3 audiences.

Stay tuned for updates on upcoming projects and initiatives from this dynamic partnership. Together, GGI and Shrapnel are poised to redefine the gaming landscape and unlock the full potential of blockchain technology.

About GGI

GGI is the leading Web3 group that serves as the definitive gateway to gaming for builders and mass players with cutting-edge infrastructure, platform and top-tier investment, incubation, and publishing services.

Social Links: MixMarvel | Yeeha! Games

About Shrapnel

SHRAPNEL is an intensely competitive extraction shooter developed by BAFTA and Emmy Award–winning game industry veterans at NEON. SHRAPNEL features high-stakes skill-based play, a suite of creator tools, and a community marketplace. At last, players will truly own the game.

item.title: GGI and Avalanche Join Forces to Power the Next Wave of High-Quality Games & Communities
item.dc:creator: MIXMARVEL
item.content:encoded:
Galaxy Girl Interactive (GGI), is a prominent leader in blockchain gaming co-founded by MixMarvel and Yeeha! Games, announcing the partnership with Avalanche, the cutting-edge blockchain platform renowned for its gaming-centric infrastructure. This collaboration marks a pivotal step toward uniting gaming communities globally, revitalizing the gaming ecosystem, and promoting high-quality gaming content through curated, engaging events.

Unifying the Global Gaming Community

A key focus of the partnership is fostering collaboration across regions and uniting fragmented gaming communities. The partnership begins with the launch of a special “Game Nights” series of GamingOnAvax in the whole year of 2025, co-hosted by GGI and Avalanche. The two partners will introduce engaging campaigns, exclusive content, and interactive events designed to bridge communities, encourage cross-regional participation, and nurture long-term player engagement.

Avalanche’s successful track record in supporting high-profile gaming projects complements GGI’s expertise in incubating promising titles and building sustainable ecosystems. Together, they will work to expand the utility of core gaming assets and drive meaningful adoption among players worldwide.

“This collaboration with Avalanche is more than a technical alliance – it’s about bringing communities together,” said Jade, Board Member at GGI. “With GGI’s incubation network and vibrant player base, combined with Avalanche’s proven infrastructure and support for benchmark gaming projects, we are excited to celebrate new milestones together with the gaming community.”

Fusing Excellence with Community-Driven Content

By leveraging Avalanche’s high-speed, scalable blockchain network, GGI aims to spotlight Avalanche in front of its growing portfolio of games and active player communities benefit from frictionless in-game transactions, low costs, and a secure environment – all of which are essential factors for a seamless gaming experience.

GGI’s extensive publishing resources and strong relationships with leading APAC game studios, content providers, and IP holders will bring a wealth of high-quality games to the potential partnership. The upcoming Game Nights series in the whole 2025 will serve as an inviting platform for players to discover and engage with trending titles brought forth by both gaming ecosystems.

Through this collaboration, GGI and Avalanche are not only expanding their reach but also exploring the framework for the gaming industry, where accessibility, engagement, and rewards are paramount for players and creators alike. By combining their expertise and resources, the partners will ensure that players enjoy seamless gaming experiences, enhanced asset interoperability and engaging community activities during and beyond the Game Nights events.

Laying the Groundwork for Long-Term Gaming Growth

GGI and Avalanche are aligned in their vision to cultivate sustainable growth within the gaming industry with a strong emphasis on community engagement and empowerment. Both parties are committed to consistently delivering high-quality games, community-driven initiatives, and value-added services that contribute to the long-term development of Web3 gaming. Together, they aim to create a fertile and dynamic environment where players, creators, and developers can flourish, setting new standards for gaming innovation and community engagement.

About GGI:

Galaxy Girl Interactive is a leading blockchain gaming platform committed to creating innovative gaming experiences through cutting-edge technology and strategic partnerships. GGI focuses on delivering high-quality games while fostering a vibrant gaming community.

About Avalanche:

Avalanche is a high-performance blockchain platform designed for builders who need to scale. Supported by a global community of developers and validators, Avalanche offers a fast, low-cost environment for building the next generation of decentralized applications. With its unique blend of speed, flexibility, and scalability, Avalanche is the preferred choice for innovators pushing the boundaries of blockchain technology.

item.title: GGI (MixMarvel) Partners with Kaia DLT Foundation to Transform Asian Blockchain Gaming Landscape
item.dc:creator: MIXMARVEL
item.content:encoded:
Galaxy Girl Interactive (GGI), the leading blockchain gaming platform co-founded by MixMarvel and Yeeha! Games, as one of the hosts, co-organized the Kaia Community Connect @2025 Consensus event with Kaia Wave. At the same time, GGI has announced a landmark partnership with Kaia DLT Foundation, the non-profit driving the ecosystem expansion of the Kaia public blockchain. This collaboration includes the launch of GGI’s incubated Mini Dapp games on LINE messenger’s Dapp Portal, marking a pivotal moment for both organizations. This will also redefine the blockchain gaming space across key Asian markets while driving value creation for content creators and mass users alike.

A Transformative Step in APAC Gaming

Following by GGI-incubated Mini Dapp games’ successful launch through Kaia Wave, a program co-led by the Kaia chain and LINE NEXT to support and empower creative Web3 builders within Asia’s largest Web3 ecosystem, the partnership underscores GGI’s ambition to dominate the burgeoning APAC blockchain gaming market, leveraging Kaia Wave’s extensive influence across high-value regions such as Japan, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and Thailand. By combining Kaia’s deep market insights and ecosystem resources with GGI’s rich content matrix and innovative gaming platform, the collaboration ensures a seamless blend of premium content and culturally resonant gaming experiences.

“This partnership represents a monumental leap forward for GGI,” said Jade, CEO at GGI. “By integrating Kaia’s unparalleled market reach with our cutting-edge gaming innovations, we’re poised to deliver exceptional Web3 gaming experiences to millions of players across Asia.”

A Wave to Unlock Boundless Potential

At the core of this partnership is Kaia’s unique ability to empower Web3 builders through its Mini Dapp ecosystem, seamlessly integrated within the LINE messenger app. With a combined user base of over 196 million, the Kaia ecosystem transforms Web3 engagement into a hassle-free, hands-on experience, enabling users to connect, create, and contribute with the speed and ease of Web2 platforms.

Joining force with Kaia will serve as a key milestone in GGI’s market strategy, offering localized content tailored to regional preferences. This will also unlock publishing opportunities in dynamic markets, while providing tools and exposure to elevate creators within the gaming sector. This integration fosters greater accessibility and engagement for high-quality gaming content and renowned IPs while ensuring that games and features resonate deeply with diverse user bases.

Empowering the GGI Ecosystem and Beyond

This partnership also fuels Kaia’s broader objectives by integrating GGI’s premium gaming content and expanding value inflow within the ecosystem. Through this synergy, GGI’s partnered gaming studios, developers and creators will gain access to highly engaged audiences via LINE’s Dapp Portal, while benefiting from streamlined interactions across Web2 and Web3 platforms.

This strategic alliance cements GGI’s position as a prominent player in the Asian blockchain gaming space, reinforcing its commitment to delivering meaningful value to mass players. By contributing top-tier content to the Kaia Wave program and its ecosystem down the road, GGI amplifies the program’s ability to strengthen creator ecosystems and onboard newbu users and consumers into the Web3 space. These efforts drive long-term loyalty and engagement while boosting the overall value of both platforms.

“Partnering with GGI perfectly aligbuns with Kaia’s mission to empower builders and redefine the Web3 experience for users across Asia,” said Dr. Sam Seo, Chairman of Kaia DLT Foundation. “Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities for blockchain gaming and community building, while introducing and expanding easy and innovative Web3 use cases.”

A Vision for the Future

Looking ahead, the partnership between GGI and the Kaia chain will expand publishing footprints across Asia’s top markets, introduce innovative localized games, and bolster creator empowerment through advanced tools and resources. Starting by driving adoption of the Kaia Wave program, the collaboration reinforces its status as Asia’s premier Web3 ecosystem, setting new benchmarks for excellence in the industry.

Through this collaboration, GGI and Kaia are redefining the blockchain gaming experience for millions, creating opportunities for creators, and pioneering the next wave of innovation in the Web3 space. As an early participant and supporter in the mini game and consumer application sector, GGI continues to reach new heights. Find out more in the upcoming announcements on the group’s exciting cross-ecosystem developments and collaborative efforts.

About GGI:

Galaxy Girl Interactive is a leading blockchain gaming platform committed to creating innovative gaming experiences through cutting-edge technology and strategic partnerships. GGI focuses on delivering high-quality games while fostering a vibrant gaming community.

About Kaia:

Kaia is a high performance public blockchain that brings Web3 to the fingertips of hundreds of millions across Asia. Formed through the merger of the Klaytn and Finschia blockchains that were initially developed by Kakao and LINE respectively, Kaia is Asia’s largest Web3 ecosystem integrated with the Kakaotalk and LINE messengers that have a combined user base of over 250 million – all of whom can experience Web3 with the ease and speed of Web2 within their favourite messenger superapp to connect, create, collaborate, and contribute to the ecosystem.

item.title: MixMarvel Announces the Launch of the MIX Buyback Plan to Drive Sustainable Ecosystem Growth
item.dc:creator: MIXMARVEL
item.content:encoded:
[Jan. 2025] MixMarvel, Asia’s leading Web3 gaming incubator and publisher, officially announced today that it will initiate a $MIX token buyback program with revenue generated from its ecosystem. The buyback program will be conducted on Bithumb. This initiative aims to enhance the value of $MIX, reward its long-term community and token holders, and provide stronger support for the sustainable development of the ecosystem.

Buyback Plan

With an estimated $1.5 million revenue scale per month, MixMarvel will allocate 30% of the ecosystem revenue each month for the buyback of $MIX tokens. The repurchased $MIX tokens will be distributed according to the following proportions to maximize their value for the ecosystem and token holders:

  1. Incorporation into the Treasury to Support Future Ecosystem Development (70%)
  • Rewarding Ecosystem Contributors: Community members and developers who continuously contribute to the MixMarvel ecosystem will receive airdrop incentives, encouraging the emergence of more high-quality content and projects.
  • Funding Support: Provide necessary funding for future ecosystem projects, game development, new feature launches, and more, ensuring the sustainable growth of the ecosystem.
  • Strategic Partnerships and Market Promotion: Support deep collaborations with partners, invest in marketing activities, brand building, and community expansion to comprehensively enhance MIX’s market recognition and user base.

2. Staking Rewards (30%)

  • Liquidity Staking Rewards: Implement a liquidity staking reward mechanism within MixMarvel Gashapon to encourage users to hold and stake MIX tokens long-term, increasing token holding rates and user engagement.
  • Incentive Mechanism: The more tokens staked and the longer the staking period, the more frequently users can participate in proposal voting and receive greater rewards, further enhancing the ecosystem’s decentralization and active community participation.

Leading the Charge in Blockchain Gaming and Ecosystem Growth

MixMarvel’s $MIX buyback program emphasizes the company’s dedication to ecosystem development and represents a significant advancement in its journey within the global Web3 gaming space. By reducing the circulating supply of $MIX tokens, the program aims to enhance their scarcity and increase market demand. This initiative reflects MixMarvel’s commitment to creating greater value for token holders, giving back to the community’s support, and fostering the ongoing development of the ecosystem.

Please follow MixMarvel’s official channels as well as the Foundation update (0x93A0C2fcbbf1A7ADcDEAa759d9e909498bA7f598) to stay updated on the latest progress and related news regarding the buyback plan.

item.title: MixMarvel’s Comprehensive Ecosystem: Empowering Global Game Developers, Creators, and Players
item.dc:creator: MIXMARVEL
item.content:encoded:
MixMarvel stands at the forefront of the Web3 revolution with a comprehensive ecosystem designed to redefine the future of blockchain gaming. As a pioneering investor, incubator and publisher, MixMarvel brings together cutting-edge infrastructure, innovative gaming experiences and dynamic community engagement under one cohesive platform to empower developers, players and partners to seamlessly explore new opportunities in the decentralized gaming space.

A Flourishing Ecosystem

MixMarvel has made a monumental step co-founding Web3 gaming group Galaxy Girl Interactive (GGI) alongside its closest ally, Yeeha! Games. This bold step reflects MixMarvel’s commitment to uniting the industry’s brightest minds and most innovative platforms to expand the gaming ecosystem and accelerate blockchain adoption through collaboration. GGI, as a collective force, pools expertise, resources, and influence to unlock unprecedented opportunities for builders, players, and investors in the Web3 space, with MixMarvel leading the charge as a beacon of innovation.

Multi-dimensional Growth

With its rich experience in the blockchain gaming space, MixMarvel understands that gaming is not only the most engaging vertical in crypto but also one of the most intricate. A successful gaming ecosystem demands the seamless integration of multiple components, from robust infrastructure to innovative financial tools and compelling content.

Over the years, MixMarvel has meticulously built and refined a comprehensive ecosystem to address these challenges:

  • Established an investment arm MixMarvel DAO Venture, successfully investing in dozens of projects and empowering them to achieve remarkable success
  • Developed island3, an innovative Chain Adaptor that unlocks seamless cross-chain communication, effortless system integration, and smart contract execution
  • Developed Yeeha! Wallet, a modular and highly customizable middleware designed to accelerate the mass adoption of gaming
  • Launched MixMarvel Gashapon, a yield aggregator poised to revolutionize the way users engage with digital assets
  • Partnered with a diverse range of games to deliver users with enhanced, cutting-edge gaming content.

From its high-performance infrastructure product suite to gamified DeFi solutions, publishing pipelines, and investment initiatives, MixMarvel has established all the foundational pillars needed to foster sustainable growth and deliver unparalleled gaming experiences.

Even in the face of market challenges, which some deem a “winter” for gaming, MixMarvel has remained steadfast in its mission. It has showcased success stories that underline the potential of Web3 gaming, leading go-to-market for high-quality gaming projects and forming alliances with top partners in the gaming space to empower indie builders and creators. By consistently delivering results and driving innovation during uncertain times, MixMarvel has proven itself as a resilient leader, inspiring confidence among its partners and community.

Game-changing Journey Ahead

Simultaneously, MixMarvel continues to enhance its ecosystem with ambitious plans outlined in its recently announced roadmap. The development of MIX Chain, MixMarvel’s ecosystem blockchain dedicated to gaming, marks a significant step forward, bringing expanded utility to its core asset, $MIX, and creating new opportunities for ecosystem participants. Complementing this infrastructure are strategic partnerships with over 20 games, including projects featuring globally renowned IPs, further solidifying MixMarvel’s position as a top-tier incubator and publisher in the Web3 space.

With a comprehensive ecosystem built to empower all aspects of blockchain gaming, MixMarvel is not only shaping the future of decentralized entertainment but also ensuring that its impact resonates far beyond the gaming industry. By embracing innovation, fostering collaboration, and remaining committed to its vision, MixMarvel is setting the stage for a transformative year ahead, poised to lead the Web3 gaming sector into its next era of growth.

About MixMarvel

MixMarvel is the world’s leading blockchain content incubation platform and creator community. By integrating globally renowned IPs and high-quality content, MixMarvel primarily offers investment, content incubation, and publishing services. It aims to foster community co-creation by investing in and collaborating with the creator community, connecting investors, entrepreneurs and mass users, and building a new generation of decentralized application ecosystem.

item.title: MixMarvel Unveils Gaming Partnerships to Expand $MIX Utility and Activate the Ecosystem

MixMarvel, a pioneering Web3 gaming content incubator and publisher, has announced its robust gaming partner matrix, solidifying its leadership in the blockchain gaming space. With strategic partnerships and collaborations featuring high-quality gaming projects, MixMarvel continues to set the standard for innovation, engagement, and sustainable growth in the gaming ecosystem.

At the heart of this expansion lies $MIX, the ecosystem’s native token, which plays a critical role in fueling the vibrant MixMarvel universe. Joining forces with a curated selection of successful flagship games and an exciting lineup of upcoming titles, MixMarvel is creating new opportunities to enhance $MIX token utility and foster a vibrant player community.

Emerging Titles to Watch

MixMarvel’s astute investment acumen and strong incubation expertise has been pivotal in identifying and supporting high-potential blockchain projects. MixMarvel has formed alliances with emerging gaming titles that are poised to set new benchmarks in the gaming industry. The portfolio includes highly anticipated titles that stand at the intersection of artistry and gameplay, crafted to engage, challenge, and inspire:

  • Tcom Arena
  • Snake Online
  • ATMAN
  • Yokai Odyssey
  • Galaxy Miner
  • Almost A Hero
  • Isekai Adventure
  • Ludo BTC
  • Iron Bullet
  • Defenders League
  • Monster Collector
  • Dream Etole
  • PartyBuddy

Gaming Partner Highlights

The MixMarvel gaming alliance is represented an impressive cohort of successful titles that have captivated global gaming communities:

  • MetaCene: MetaCene has successfully achieved multi-chain deployment, enabling players to access the game on the Mantle Network. Additionally, a new version of the game is set to be launched in the near future. Endorsed by the BNB Chain incubation program in 2023, MetaCene has achieved remarkable milestones, including 2.5M on-chain transactions during Alpha3 and a Gold Rush Season that drew 86,145 monthly active users, 22,000 token holders, and a $2M trading volume.
  • SimDunk: A 3v3 cyberpunk basketball game on the innovative SimSports platform. Set in an immersive cyberpunk universe, the game offers players an adrenaline-packed experience through real-time competitions, strategic gameplay, and a robust reward system. SimDunk’s 2nd Pioneer Test attracted over 8,000 participants with an average online time of 185 minutes per player. It set unprecedented retention rates, with a 81.67% second-day retention and 58.91% seven-day retention, highlighting its strong community appeal.

Driving Sustainable Growth

MixMarvel’s ecosystem thrives on the exceptional performance of these game-changing projects and their innovative integration of NFTs and DeFi mechanisms. MixMarvel’s closest gaming partners — such as MetaCene and SimDunk — have driven remarkable user engagement and revenue growth while reinforcing $MIX’s utility.

As MetaCene’s long-term partner, MixMarvel has facilitated large-scale campaigns, community events and ecosystem collaborations with the game, encouraging MixMarvel eco participants and incubated projects to interact with each other, fostering a more tightknit player-creator community within the MixMarvel platform that lays the foundation for more diverse and organic use cases for $MIX token.

SimDunk’s forthcoming platform token, $BRAVO, is also set to benefit active players and ecosystem contributors while enhancing the value of $MIX. These milestones exemplify MixMarvel’s ability to connect with and support high-quality projects that contribute to the sustainable expansion of its ecosystem.

Building the Future of Web3 Gaming

MixMarvel remains committed to driving innovation and inclusivity within the Web3 gaming space. Through its strategic gaming partner alliance and strong focus on community engagement, MixMarvel is shaping the future of blockchain gaming. By uniting the force of top-tier Web3 games to provide players and creators with unparalleled opportunities to engage with the ecosystem, MixMarvel is not only expanding $MIX’s utility but also setting the stage for the next era of decentralized entertainment.

item.title: MixMarvel Unveils 2025 Roadmap: Unlocking $MIX Token Value Through Ecosystem Growth
item.dc:creator: MIXMARVEL
item.content:encoded:
As the leading blockchain gaming incubator and publisher, MixMarvel is poised to make 2025 a year of groundbreaking achievements to increase the value of $MIX token. With a robust roadmap focused on activating and enhancing the MixMarvel ecosystem, the company is set to expand the utility of the $MIX token and generate unprecedented value for holders, players, and partners. By integrating cutting-edge infrastructure, innovative gaming projects, and strategic partnerships, MixMarvel is laying the foundation for sustainable, multi-faceted growth across its platform.

Gaming & IPs: Expanding the Creative Horizon

In 2025, MixMarvel plans to launch a slate of incubated titles designed to merge artistic excellence with gameplay innovation. These titles promise to engage and inspire gaming enthusiasts while reinforcing the $MIX token as the linchpin of the MixMarvel universe. The lineup features a diverse gaming matrix with 10+ mid-core games, 7 mini-games and 5 large-scale games. Additionally, it highlights the contributions of 15 esteemed game studios.

Investment: Fueling Innovation Across the Industry

MixMarvel DAO Venture is leveraging its influence to nurture high-potential projects and ecosystems through strategic investments:

  • VC Alliance with Renowned institution investors: MixMarvel DAO Venture joins forces with some renowned institutional investors to support the next generation of consumer-facing games. As a strategic partner of the VC Alliance, MixMarvel DAO Venture will provide funding, mentorship, developer support, and marketing opportunities to bolster the web3 gaming ecosystem.
  • Empowering promising projects in gaming and beyond: MixMarvel DAO Venture is continuing its mission to identify and support promising projects in gaming, AI, DeFi, infrastructure, and consumer applications with resources and advisory services.

Infrastructure: Strengthening the Ecosystem Core

Infrastructure remains a key pillar of MixMarvel’s 2025 growth strategy:

  • Develop MixMarvel Own Blockchain：MixMarvel will launch its own blockchain, bringing $MIX more use cases and enhanced utility within the ecosystem.
  • Island3: This cutting-edge and innovative Chain Adaptor will officially initiate its commercialization efforts, including a public brand debut, developer incentives, and product releases.
  • Yeeha! Wallet: A major brand and product upgrade is on the horizon, with integrations into MixMarvel’s publishing pipeline set to accelerate ecosystem growth.

DeFi: Bridging Gaming and Finance

GGI’s innovative DeFi initiatives will create new avenues for community engagement and ecosystem growth:

  • Gashapon: This gamified yield aggregator will integrate with the GGI ecosystem, offering staking, launchpad features, and more to players and DeFi users.

Strategic Expansion: Building a Global Network

MixMarvel is set to strengthen its global footprint through strategic partnerships and market penetration initiatives:

  • Partnerships: Collaborations with industry leaders across investment, infrastructure, IPs, and gaming will unite resources and talent to co-create a thriving Web3 ecosystem.
  • Market Penetration: With a focus on APAC and beyond, MixMarvel will launch localized campaigns and offline activations in key markets such as Japan , South Korea, Greater China and Southeast Asia like Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam. These efforts aim to bring products with strong market fit to new audiences, unlocking opportunities and onboarding users into Web3.

A Vision for 2025 and Beyond

2025 will be the year for increasing the value of $MIX token through the activation and enhancement of the $MIX ecosystem. By driving innovation, forging strategic alliances, and enhancing $MIX utility, MixMarvel is shaping a future where Web3 gaming achieves mass adoption and delivers meaningful value to all stakeholders. The MixMarvel ecosystem invites gamers, developers, and partners to join this exciting journey as it pioneers the next chapter in blockchain gaming.

For more updates and opportunities within the MixMarvel ecosystem, stay tuned for announcements in 2025. Together, we build a sustainable and thriving Web3 future.

About MixMarvel

MixMarvel is the world’s leading blockchain content incubation platform and creator community. By integrating globally renowned IPs and high-quality content, MixMarvel primarily offers investment, content incubation, and publishing services. It aims to foster community co-creation by investing in and collaborating with the creator community, connecting investors, entrepreneurs and mass users, and building a new generation of decentralized application ecosystem.

About $MIX

$MIX is the native token of the MixMarvel ecosystem, designed to power the next generation of Web3 gaming experiences. Through innovative tokenomics and strategic utility, $MIX facilitates seamless interactions within the ecosystem while creating value for all participants.
